purpose: Table-driven native options (crate::configuration::VALUE_OPTIONS): config_setting(values) matching through each option's converter (case rules, toString, conversion errors), the command-line forms of the command-line rows, the exec transition (propagated / default / set), the configuration identity (a default spelled explicitly is the default configuration, a transitioned value's ST- root), and query's `Unrecognized option` for options of other fragments. Rows: ProtoConfiguration.Options experimental_proto_descriptor_sets_include_source_info, strict_proto_deps, strict_public_imports (command line + config_setting); CoreOptions collect_code_coverage and AppleCommandLineOptions apple_platform_type (config_setting only). Motivation: protobuf 33.4's bazel/private/native_bool_flag.bzl config_settings (`values = {flag: match_value}` on the three proto options) blocked every analysis depending on @protobuf.

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; default registry (bcr.bazel.build); one fresh copy of the fixture workspace per case (platforms extracted from tests/fixtures/label_repo_name/platforms_archive.json)

script.path: /tmp/opencode/perf-research/pts-vo-capture.py, pts-vo-receipt.py (not committed; copies of value-options-capture.py, value-options-receipt.py)

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy; <OB> = the genuine output base; <CACHE> = the native cache; elapsed times <T>. Native stdout/outputs paths are below the action output root (`.../outputs/`).
comparison (tests/value_options.rs, live: MATCH: success equal (genuine exit 0 <=> native exit 0); WARNING lines equal in order; Bazel's first ERROR message (an external repository's location reduced to its BUILD file name) ends a native stderr line; built outputs (path below bazel-out -> contents, so output roots included) equal; query stdout equal. DECLARED_DIVERGENCE: genuine succeeds, native fails with the recorded explicit message.
genuine_key_findings: --strict_proto_deps / --strict_public_imports (StrictDepsConverter, an EnumConverter over StrictDepsMode): case-insensitive values (`off`, `OFF`, `Strict`, `Warn`), `default` is the distinct constant DEFAULT (not the option default ERROR); `--strict_proto_deps=loose`: `While parsing option --strict_proto_deps=loose: Not a valid strict dependency checking level: 'loose' (should be off, warn, error, strict or default)` (exit 2); `--nostrict_proto_deps :: Illegal use of 'no' prefix on non-boolean option: --nostrict_proto_deps`; the last occurrence wins.

--experimental_proto_descriptor_sets_include_source_info (BooleanConverter): `--x`, `--nox`, `--x=YES`, `--x=1`; `--x=maybe`: `'maybe' is not a boolean`; `--nox=false :: Unexpected value after boolean option: --nox=false`.

config_setting(values) converts the expected value like the command line (`ERROR`, `Strict`, `YES`, `0` all convert; the conversion errors are attribute errors `in values attribute of config_setting rule //pkg:NAME: error while parsing configuration settings: While parsing option --NAME=VALUE: ...`, exit 1).

The three proto options propagate to the exec configuration (the exec tool sees --strict_proto_deps=off etc.); the exec root stays k8-opt-exec and the top-level root k8-fastbuild (the top-level configuration is its own baseline).

protobuf's native_bool_flag pattern in an external module: strict_proto_deps is True unless --strict_proto_deps=off (warn keeps True); experimental_proto_descriptor_sets_include_source_info follows the flag.

collect_code_coverage: `{"collect_code_coverage": "false"}` and `"no"` match by default; a Starlark transition setting it gives the root k8-fastbuild-ST-0a6d1b0f07f2 on both sides (the hash of `//command_line_option:collect_code_coverage=true`) and its exec tool is not covered (not propagated); `'sometimes' is not a boolean`.

apple_platform_type (PlatformTypeConverter lower-cases the expected value): `macos` and `MacOS` match by default, also in the exec configuration (the exec transition sets macos); `ios` and `""` do not.
enable_runfiles (CoreOptions TriState, default auto): `{"enable_runfiles": "true"}` (bazel_lib's //lib:enable_runfiles) does not match by default (`!enable_runfiles`).

query registers only CoreOptions: `--strict_proto_deps=off :: Unrecognized option: --strict_proto_deps=off` (also `--strict_public_imports` with a separate value, `--[no]experimental_proto_descriptor_sets_include_source_info`, `--apple_platform_type=ios`), no did-you-mean suggestion, exit 2; `query --collect_code_coverage` is accepted.
known_divergences: Exit codes of command-line errors: genuine 2, native 1 (native's single error channel); success/failure always agrees.
Native prints its own result format (`LABEL\tPATH` on stdout, `bazel-rs: N actions executed ...`) and no INFO lines.

Declared divergences (verdict DECLARED_DIVERGENCE): --collect_code_coverage and --apple_platform_type on the command line, a Starlark transition writing a proto option: explicit native errors. config_setting on enable_runfiles (case unmodelled_enable_runfiles, named before the option was modelled) now matches: CoreOptions.enableRunfiles is a table-driven row (tests/fixtures/enable_runfiles_option).
Native needs --experimental-builtin-modules for the exec cases (the default host platform's @platforms//host); it is passed in every native case.
